name: workflow-file-read-as-yaml-and-held-whole
description: A workflow file is read as a YAML document, so a step whose run command an alias names, a step written as a flow mapping and a run command written on the line after a comment-only key line each run node on the file they name, and those files are rooted. The workflow file's whole text is held as well, so a file only a job's env names, which no command reads, is held, nothing it exports is reported, and the package has one note. A file nothing names is still reported.
